steps.text: Some ecologists have categorized all the fowlbeasts on this great land into two categories—'Wayfowls' and 'Homefowls'.

The former will, owing to climatic and ecological shifts, constantly relocate as they look for the most suitable habitat for survival; while the latter once settled in their habitat, will stay for good, and stop at nothing to protect their homes.

This biological theory was later borrowed by historians to suggest that 'all conflict between the races on this continent stems from the differing views between those who can only live in one place and those who drift nomadically.'
Afterwards came yet another supplementary addition to this viewpoint.
There were originally no Homefowls on this great land, but as the fowlbeasts gradually gathered in places, built their homes together, and created a collective memory, the Homefowls came to be.

steps.name: Girl looking for Siesta
steps.text: I won't miss it this time. According to the route on this map, Siesta is just right over this peak.

steps.name: Girl looking for Siesta
steps.text: Siesta, is right here...
She looks all around her, but only snow fills her vision.

steps.name: Girl looking for Siesta
steps.text: Where... where am I?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yo. Been a while.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: Oh? What brings the Emperor here to Siesta, without an Obsidian Festival to draw him? And your shirt, it seems something burned a hole through it...?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I'ma ax you to change the topic here.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: I collected a good amount of material in the last few days, and should be able to quickly put out an album after I return to Columbia.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ain't a lotta musicians I look forward to, Byrd, but you one of 'em.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: I can't help but recall the first Obsidian Festival I attended, when I was chatting with Barbara about the future of Siesta she saw.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: If one day, when this city leaves the volcano and obsidian, leaves the charming scenery and coastline, just what will remain of it?

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: She said that music is a kind of carrier, but the most important carriers are actually the people living here.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: As long as there are people willing to sing in joy or even sorrow, as long as they're willing to enjoy the sunset afterglow for a moment when evening comes, Siesta will remain the same.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Young people can't get all hung up on nostalgia. Makes the music stale.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: That's a little too harsh, Emperor.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: Even in our fleeting lifetimes, you can feel lost if you don't occasionally look back at the path you've traveled.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: You have to look back from time to time, to see if you've left anything precious behind on the road.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: So now that all the past's done been buried under that volcano, how's about an Obsidian Festival 2.0? Just so happens I got me some investment plans.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: If we want to revive it, should we come up with a new name too?

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: Volcano Festival? That seems a bit too obvious... Oh, right. I did see an adorable creature on this trip. How does 'Marshmallow Festival' sound?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Dayum, Byrd. Your taste in ain't one thousandth as good as your music.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The volcano observation data is all here, Professor Keller.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: We've collected some really valuable information, and I'll go back after sorting these out.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: Thank you for all your work...

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: You really are already a scholar in your own right. Katia and Magna would be proud.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: This protective gear is also... compared to the one in the display, it really is...
The scholar's voice trails off, and she stares at the familiar coat for a long, long time.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I want to scale more volcanoes in my mother's gear. It'll keep me safe. I want to thank you too for your guidance during this time, I've really learned a lot.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: By the way, where's Kahn?

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: He's gone back to Leithanien early for work.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Professor Keller, I want to apologize to you on Kahn's behalf. He must have misunderstood something...

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: ...Don't mention it.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: Adele... have you never suspected me of anything?
Adele lightly shakes her head.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I know very little about that period of time, and it seems like everyone was deliberately hiding it from me.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: But I saw my parents' notes, and that photo too...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I just can't believe that someone who has been them on so many volcanoes, and through so many dangers, would ever do something to betray them...

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: There's something I want to show you.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: These papers are probably what Kahn was trying to find.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: Aside from the copy stored in the Leithanian archives, the only other that exists is with me.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: These are discarded documents, so it's nothing confidential, but I was only hoping no one would ever come looking for them again...
The scholar retrieves a cardboard box from the bookcase, the personal effects of two other scholars within the small container.
The aged document case has words like 'Highly Confidential' written on it, with an 'Obsolete' stamped on top.
'Projekt Regenschauer'.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Is this... Vati's military research project...?

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: Katia and Magna both wished to stay pure scholars their whole lives, and indeed they strived to fulfil this ideal.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: But reality means it can be hard to stay pure...

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: After the coup in Leithanien more than two decades ago, they were always getting caught up in disputes between the nobles. So they had to make some compromises in order to continue their research work.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: Katia handed over some of his research results to the army in exchange for a relatively peaceful academic environment, while I helped him with some of the follow-up liaison work.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: But they pinned their hopes on you.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: They hoped to keep these impure disputes out of your life, so that you could study whatever you wanted without any distractions.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: That is also my wish, as well...

I hope that when people talk of the Naumanns many years later, they will only remember them as pure academics and great scientists, and that their only child can explore the depths of knowledge without any worries.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Vati and Mutti... were their deaths, really an accident...?

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: During that Mount Unna observation, an envoy from Leithanien paid us another visit, just as we were preparing to scale the volcano.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: I was hoping they could complete their work without any inference, so I offered to help them shrug off the military. I didn't expect that mishap...

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: Adele, I dare not ask for your forgiveness...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Professor Keller, why do you think this is your fault?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I won't question my parents' belief in scientific research because of this, and I certainly wouldn't question you either, Professor Keller.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: All of you tried your best for an ideal, so isn't it just too unfair to take on any more blame...?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I think that's how Vati and Mutti would feel too.

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: I will always remember the summer when Katia and Magna came to Siesta. Meeting them was the luckiest thing to ever happen to me.
That day, a pair of strange foreign tourists walked into the coffee shop, sat at the table next to mine, and changed my life.
I got to see a wider, a more beautiful world beyond what you read in the books. I had the best time of my life.
From Siesta to Leithanien, and many more places besides, many more volcanoes, and many more adventures.
I wish I could accompany them on another journey.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Professor Keller, can I give you a hug?
The scholar takes the girl into her arms, gently resting her forehead against hers.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Professor Keller, can I stay here for a while, just by myself?

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: Of course.
The girl flips through the old documents one after another, and finds a handwritten letter at the bottom of the pile.

a.text: '...The above information comes from two scientists who are incomparably devoted to science.

spans.text: '...The above information comes from two scientists who are incomparably devoted to science.

a.text: 'They spent and gave their whole lives to scientific research, in hopes of using knowledge to protect humanity, seeking a safer and better home.

spans.text: 'They spent and gave their whole lives to scientific research, in hopes of using knowledge to protect humanity, seeking a safer and better home.

a.text: 'I hope this will be taken in earnest, and this research is used for the right cause.'

spans.text: 'I hope this will be taken in earnest, and this research is used for the right cause.'

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Professor Keller's name... is actually...
In the corner of the letter is a beautiful signature.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Liv!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Lay back, and don’t move.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: How's Liv—

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Calm down, she's gone home. That little one was scared out of her wits, but suffered no real injuries—you're the one that needs worrying.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Good... that's good to hear...
The young man drops back into his bed in relief.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Just how... many days was I out for?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Three whole days.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Your mom and even your siblings came to visit you everyday. Do you know just how worried they were?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Spare me your lecture just this once, Dr. Ceylon.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I was also... saving someone, right...? I'm so ready to lecture that little sister of mine...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hmph, still trying to hide it? Do you think a doctor wouldn't be able to tell?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You've got some nerve to actually study Arts in secret. Do you know just how high your Blood Originium-Crystal Density was, when you were wheeled in here?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Is this...?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Is this treatment... expensive?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Heh, even if you were to get a job at Rhodes Island, I estimate it'd cost you a couple of paychecks.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Haha... I guess I really have no choice now...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But speaking of which, I'm currently preparing to establish a treatment center for Infected people here in Siesta. I'm just starting up, so I'll need plenty of helping hands.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Would you like to consider staying to help me out?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Dr. Ceylon, thanks for the offer, but I already made a deal with my family... I won't be staying in Siesta for a while.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: If it's possible, I'd rather take a look at the landship you mentioned that goes to many places.
Even if they aren't by my side, family will always be family. I can try to live for myself, and do what I really want to do. I also want to see the sights that my dad has seen.
Being an explorer sure sounds like a pretty cool job.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What's that sound?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Oh, it must be Swire's construction crew. She really moves fast. The ink on the contract probably hasn't even dried yet.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: White Volcano...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Dr. Ceylon! I have to head back first, I'll pay my bills later!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Done with work?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Mhm, that was the last patient. Phew... I've been so busy working on the treatment center these last few days that I haven't had the time to hear about what you've been up to...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Just some missions for Rhodes Island is all. I went to a few more countries, and got to know more Operators too.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: When this vacation is over, I might go on some longer missions, or be stationed somewhere for a while.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hm, I do want to come with you, but I really can't leave right now. Besides, you wouldn't want me to, right?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Yes, it would be meaningless otherwise.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: How about I take you around here for the next few days then?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Sure. Siesta has become even prettier than the last time I was here.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'm sure you'll see an even better Siesta on your next visit.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I believe in you, Milady.

Autumn has yet to fully arrive, the sunlight is still warm, but the weather seems to suddenly cool down considerably. There seems to be more people playing in the streets, and a few surprising queues leaking out of some shops.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Please, please don't tear it down, not yet!)

steps.name: Enis

steps.text: Enis? Aren't you supposed to be in a hospital bed—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Did they already tear down the White—
Enis spots the brand new signage at the shop entrance before he finishes speaking.
In addition to replacing the damaged light bulb, Harley has also added a little doodle herself—three marshmallowy sheep, one big and two small.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Who said renovation meant a tear down? They're going to build a new water park here.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: A water park?! Then, what about the logistics center?

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: I heard that city hall redid their plans, and since Siesta still needs to retain some of our tourist attractions, this street is one of them.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Pelipper wrapped up and sold several of his shops to a foreign group, saying an investor felt that the previous events had a pretty good reception, so there's money to be made in building a waterpark here.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: So our little shop might be able to stay open for a while longer.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: We went all through that, and in the end...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Mom, whose car is that...?

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Oh, someone who came to the shop a few days ago, that rich girl? She parked it here.
A brand new pickup truck in pure white is parked in front of the shop, with a small note pressed under the wiper.

a.text: 'Helping a friend with some minor troubles.'

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: ...Thanks a bunch.
